title: SAP Message Server does not properly handle certain malformed requests, which could be leveraged by an unauthenticated…
description: SAP Message Server has a vulnerability where it does not properly handle certain malformed requests. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this by sending specially crafted input to retrieve sensitive information. This vulnerability impacts confidentiality but does not affect integrity or availability. The CVSS score is 7.5, indicating a high severity level. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
